subject: Credentialing handoff: Polaris Health — API access & admin roles
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Credentialing handoff: Polaris Health - API & admin roles

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our CS <> Implementation handoff, I'm looping in Mina (Implementation Lead) and Jonas (Infra) to pick up the technical provisioning and role mappings. Action items we discussed: 

- Polaris to confirm 1) admin roster (names + emails) and 2) the list of initial projects/environments you want seeded (sandbox, staging, prod).
- Redwood to provision a restricted integration project and seed an initial API key/service account with scoped read/write tokens for the integration team.
- Polaris security to confirm acceptable rotation window for service keys and any IP allowlist requirements.

Attached: polaris_sc_qna_v1.pdf (security questions noted), and a sample CSV template for the admin roster.

Samir — can you send the roster and call out whether you prefer service-account JSON keys or a bearer API key for CI usage? We'll map that to our role model and share a brief provisioning runbook before we create any credentials.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): polaris_sc_qna_v1.pdf, admin_roster_template.csv
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@polarishealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <it-security@polarishealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentialing handoff: Polaris Health - API & admin roles

Monica —

Appreciate the clear next steps. I've attached our current admin roster (polaris_admin_roster.csv). A few notes from our side: 

- For CI/CD we'll prefer a service-account JSON key (easier to rotate through Vault), but the integrations team would like a short-lived API bearer token option for ad-hoc testing.
- Security would like the default key expiry to be 90 days and we will enforce rotation via Vault.
- We have an IP allowlist for production traffic; I listed the ranges in the attached Q&A response.

I'll need an internal point of contact from Redwood implementation who will actually create the keys and run through a handshake for the initial calls.

Samir Rao
Director, Platform Engineering
Polaris Health

Attachments: polaris_admin_roster.csv
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentialing handoff: Polaris Health - API & admin roles

Thanks Monica / Samir (cc Jonas) — looping on the implementation plan. Proposed internal checklist before we create any credentials: 

1) Review roster and map Palo Alto role -> Redwood roles (Admin, Integration, ReadOnly).
2) Create dedicated project: polaris-integration-sbox (scoped to integration team).
3) Provision service-account JSON + single-use bearer token generator for test sessions. Token TTL defaults to 24h; production tokens will be governed by their Vault integration per Samir's ask.
4) Apply IP allowlist on the production route when Polaris confirms ranges.
5) Share provisioning runbook + minimal test prompts and tracing hooks with Polaris.

Jonas — can you prepare the service-account template (JSON stub) and the provisioning script snippet. I'll draft the customer-facing runbook and include a short checklist for security to sign off.

I'll plan to create the sandbox project and seed a key (non-prod) once we have confirmation on the roster and IP ranges.

Mina Haddad
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: service-account-template.json
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@polarishealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Credentialing handoff: Polaris Health - API & admin roles

On Sun, Dec 13, 2026 at 9:02 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samir —
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our CS <> Implementation handoff, I'm looping in Mina (Implementation Lead) and Jonas (Infra) to pick up the technical provisioning and role mappings.

Samir / Polaris team —

Next technical steps from our side (I'll execute after roster + ranges are confirmed):

- Create project: polaris-integration-sbox (labels: customer=polaris, env=sandbox).
- Generate service-account JSON key: will include roles {"integration": ["read","write"], "admin": ["manage:users"]} — we'll remove admin perms unless explicitly requested.
- Provision a short-lived bearer endpoint (token issuance) for test calls; TTL=24h by default.
- Send a provisioning confirmation email with the following artifacts: service-account JSON (secure channel), a one-page runbook (how to call /v1/generate, sample curl), and the HubSpot ticket id for audit.

Compliance notes: we will not deliver credentials over unencrypted email. I'll upload the key to a secure transfer (DocuSign/Drive access link) and share the link with Polaris once the appropriate internal approvals are recorded.

Samir — can you confirm: 1) final admin roster is the attached CSV, and 2) the IP ranges in your Q&A doc are the ones you want applied to production? Once you confirm, Mina and I will seed the sandbox key and schedule a 30-min handshake to validate calls.

-Jonas
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: service-account-template.json
